report.question: Task #120 asks to implement the change `add-zone-rules-from-iana`, but that change is already archived. It is not under openspec/changes/; it lives at openspec/changes/archive/2026/11/2026-11-12-add-zone-rules-from-iana/ (proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md, specs/zone-rules/spec.md and others). It was implemented and archived by commit efb8c21 'Compute time zone offsets from bundled IANA zone rules (#122)', which is also this task's base commit and adds packages/client/scripts/zoneRules/check.ts and openspec/specs/zone-rules/spec.md. Archived changes are immutable (.claude/rules/process-invariants.md: 'Never edit files in openspec/changes/archive/'). The only active change is `add-remote-zone-rules-updates`, which builds on add-zone-rules-from-iana (its proposal.md, line 5: '`add-zone-rules-from-iana` makes the app's own zone rules the only source of offsets...'). What should this task do?
options: Close task #120 as already done: add-zone-rules-from-iana shipped in #122
Retarget the task to the active change `add-remote-zone-rules-updates` (Change: add-remote-zone-rules-updates)
Create a new follow-up change that corrects or extends add-zone-rules-from-iana (Supersedes: add-zone-rules-from-iana). Please describe what it should fix.
